title: Family calendar deployment diagram
description: One Worker on the icelander.net zone, its D1, and the login service and friends-and-family it binds to.

nodes.name: Household member's browser
nodes.description: A phone or computer using the calendar.

nodes.name: Household admin's browser
nodes.description: The same app, used to invite, rename and remove people.

nodes.name: family-calendar Worker
nodes.description: Serves icelander.net/apps/z-calendar*, and answers icelander.net/apps/calendar* and icelander.net/calendar* with a 301 there, ahead of the site's own Worker.

nodes.name: family-calendar D1
nodes.description: Households, people, schedules, and each person's preferences.

nodes.name: accounts Worker (icelander.net)
nodes.description: The login service; reached by a service binding, never from the internet.

nodes.name: friends-and-family Worker
nodes.description: The family's people and dates; reached by a service binding for dates, and by the browser for its own pages.

artifacts.name: src/ and public/
artifacts.description: The Worker and its static assets.

artifacts.name: migrations/
artifacts.description: 0001_init.sql and 0002_user_prefs.sql, applied with wrangler d1 migrations apply.
